title: What If You Lived Inside a Cave on the Moon?

scenes.text: What if humans lived in a Moon cave? Scientists found one, and it's room temperature.
On the surface, the Moon swings from about 121 degrees Celsius by day to minus 173 at night.
But inside a pit in the Sea of Tranquility, models show a steady 17 degrees Celsius.
The pit is about 65 meters wide, and radar shows a tunnel stretching beyond it.
Overhead rock would also block micrometeorites and much of the radiation that bathes the surface.
A ready-made shelter, possibly for a future base. It's already waiting up there.

description:
What if humans lived in a cave on the Moon?
A pit in the Sea of Tranquility holds a steady 17 degrees Celsius while the surface swings by almost 300.
